lines.say: Hackers would love to hit your servers directly. Your app runs on ten of them, and bots can't reach a single one.
lines.show: Hackers would love to hit your servers directly. Your app runs on *10* of them, and bots [can't reach a single one.]

lines.say: They scan the internet all night,
lines.show: They scan the internet all night,

lines.say: and all they ever find is one machine. Not your servers.
lines.show: and all they ever find is *one machine.* Not your servers.

lines.say: That machine is called a reverse proxy: a middleman every request has to hit first.
lines.show: That machine is called a [reverse proxy:] a middleman every request has to hit first.

lines.say: Think of a restaurant. Customers never walk into the kitchen. A waiter takes your order and brings the food back.
lines.show: Think of a *restaurant.* Customers never walk into the kitchen. A *waiter* takes your order and brings the food back.

lines.say: Your servers stay private, no public address at all. Only the proxy faces the internet.
lines.show: Your servers stay *private,* no public address at all. Only the proxy [faces the internet.]

lines.say: But this waiter does more than carry plates.
lines.show: But this waiter does more than carry plates.

lines.say: It keeps popular pages ready to serve, so many requests never even reach your servers.
lines.show: It keeps popular pages ready to serve, so many requests [never even reach your servers.]

lines.say: It also reads every address: slash API is sent to these servers, images to those.
lines.show: It also reads every address: */api* is sent to these servers, *images* to those.

lines.say: Engine X and Cloudflare run this job for millions of sites.
lines.show: *NGINX* and *Cloudflare* run this job for millions of sites.

lines.say: Quick check: a forward proxy hides you from the website. A reverse proxy hides the website's servers from you.
lines.show: Quick check: a forward proxy hides *you* from the website. A reverse proxy hides [the website's servers] from you.

lines.say: If you build with AI, follow for the system design it quietly skips.
lines.show: If you build with AI, follow for the system design it quietly [skips.]
